# ZUFEK — Custom Metal Screws and Non-Standard Fasteners

> DONGGUAN ZUFEK TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. is a custom metal screw and fastener manufacturer based in Dalang, Dongguan, Guangdong, China. Established in 2005. Specifications, feasibility, capacity allocation and delivery are confirmed against each drawing and order.

## Reading guidance
Technical guides are general references. Material grade, treatment condition, tolerance, coating, inspection method and load requirements must be checked for the actual part. No catalog family implies a universal strength, pressure or lifting rating. Automotive project references concern component supply-chain applications, not a claim of direct OEM supplier approval.
